title: Printing and exiting in MIPS
description: You can follow a complete entry point through two syscall services.

steps.description: msg stores a null-terminated greeting in the data section. You declare main as a global label in the text section.
main loads service number 4 into $v0. You place the greeting's address in $a0 for the print-string service.

steps.question: Does the final syscall use the same service as the first one?
steps.answer: No. The instruction before it changes $v0 to 10, selecting the exit service.

steps.description: You see the Hello, world greeting from the first syscall. The next service exits the program after that output.
